factory.description: On a multi-user Gateway, read or update the authenticated requesting user’s personal USER.md from any Gateway chat session, including project worktrees. Use get first, preserve unrelated preferences, then set the complete content with expectedHash set to the returned hash (null only when missing). Limit 4,000 characters.
